query: A createWorkItem Server Action receives form input. The project has a CreateWorkItemSchema in the domain layer and a safe-action client that supports an input schema. Show the write path from the action to the database.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent passes CreateWorkItemSchema to the safe-action client AND parses the same schema again inside the application function, then parses the returned row with the same domain schema — the identical rule enforced twice within twenty lines, with no statement of which one is authoritative.
expected_behavior: Names three distinct boundaries: authorization plus transport decoding, the application contract, and the shape of data coming back
Declares the input schema once, next to the scenario, and does not repeat it at the inbound boundary
Keeps authorization at the inbound boundary where the request context lives
Parses the returned row against a row schema rather than re-running the input schema
Notes that the slice may have no use-case at all — the inbound adapter still declares the boundary around the data call
anti_expectation: Does NOT drop server-side validation and rely on the client form
Does NOT skip parsing data returned from the store because 'the input was already valid'
Does NOT collapse authorization into the schema check
